title: OwnedResourceControlRequest
description: common.owned-resource-control-request@1 (ADR-048 amendment 2026-10-15, step 8 phase 2): one control operation on a person-owned resource. Robots, chat rooms, restream definitions and pastes belong to a person, not to a project, so they carry no OVRN and the project-scoped common.resource-control-request@1 cannot name them. OpenVibe.Services sends this to the owning authority's POST /api/v1/resources/control (the same route, told apart by `owned`), acting for the person in on_behalf_of. owned names the resource by its index summary's kind and id. owner is the person it belongs to: the authority refuses unless its own record says the same (Services also offers actions only on the viewer's own resources). A sensitive action (deleting, physical control) asked by an agent is refused with confirmation_required until the owner approves, as for project resources. idempotency_key makes a retry safe: the authority answers a repeated key from the same caller with the first result, and refuses the key reused with another request. Answered with common.resource-control-result@1 (without resource: there is no OVRN). The actions each authority takes are in its <service>.resource.control capability; any other action is refused unsupported.

owned.description: The resource, as its owning authority's resource index lists it (common.resource-summary@1 kind and id).

id.description: The summary's id: a prefixed ULID (rob_…) or the service's own slug (a paste, a room).

owner.description: The person the resource belongs to. Person-owned resources belong to people, never to agents or apps.

params.description: Action-specific input, shaped by the authority's own contract (never redefined here).

on_behalf_of.description: Who asks: the owner, or their agent (whose sensitive actions wait for the owner's approval).

confirmation_id.description: The approved confirmation from an earlier confirmation_required answer.
